description: Webless connects ChatGPT and Codex to your authenticated Webless analytics workspace. Ask about website search demand, content engagement, visitor journeys, acquisition sources, and intent gaps. The plugin reads the current analytics catalog, runs tenant-scoped semantic queries, and can calculate comparisons or visualizations in a network-isolated sandbox. It does not accept raw SQL or allow users to select another tenant's data.

defaultPrompt: For the Acme Cloud Webless index, show daily search query volume for the last 30 complete days and visualize the trend.
For the Acme Cloud Webless index, which intent topics had the highest content-gap scores this month?
For the Acme Cloud Webless index, compare multi-question session rates across acquisition sources for the last four weeks.
